question: After smearing again with cow dung, what should be caused to be recited and when?
premises: Again smearing with cow dung is done.
An auspicious day recitation is to be caused.
inference: Again, having smeared with cow dung, one should then cause the auspicious day (recitation) to be proclaimed.
uncertainties: Exact form vācayettadā parsed as causative optative plus tadā in hinting.
plain_english: Again, having smeared with cow dung, then one should have the auspicious day proclaimed.
